reviewDecisions.rationale: A broad demand tightening is economically important and should test whether company/geography/balance-sheet heterogeneity creates any resilient expression rather than assuming all property-linked names behave the same.
The partial tax rollback creates a measurable 2017 demand reset; company product mix and market expectations can be researched before outcomes.
The first formal OPEC cut since 2008 is a clearly new supply state with direct earnings implications but immediate price absorption, making it a strong V1.9 test.
The policy reverses the earlier shortage state and can hurt coal-price continuation while benefiting downstream fuel users; both directions require company mapping.
Live implementation is structurally meaningful but principle approval predates Q4, making it a deliberate continuation control that must not use the V1.9 fresh route.
A specific environmental capacity hit arrived on top of an existing TiO2 upcycle, providing a direct test of whether V1.9 can isolate a new incremental driver from an old narrative.
